title: Gridfinity baseplate
description: A Gridfinity baseplate that fills your drawer: as many 42 mm cells as fit, centred, with filler strips to the walls, split into pieces that fit your print bed and joined by printed bowtie clips.
process: FDM printing of the pieces and clips, flat, PLA or PETG

difficulty.rationale: Topology-driven partitioning with coupled ranges, per-piece patterns and fit checks.

standards: Gridfinity, by Zack Freedman (Voidstar Lab, 2022, MIT licence): the 42 mm grid and 6 x 2 mm magnets (gridfinity.xyz/specification)

kennetek, gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad (MIT): the baseplate socket profile, the bin base profile, hole sizes and the weighted base (src/core/standard.scad, src/core/gridfinity-baseplate.scad, gridfinity-rebuilt-baseplate.scad), read as numbers
materials: PLA or PETG, two colours for the pieces (grey and green in the picture)
